messages:
maria: Hey team — opened a small PR updating SOC2 language for audit log exports + key rotation guidance. Need quick double-check before merge.
chris: link? PR number?
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472
maria: Main changes: add KMS/HSM mention, clarifying that exported logs are encrypted in transit and at rest, and add recommended key rotation cadence (90 days) example.
devon: 90 days feels aggressive for infra keys, legal ok with that?
sara-legal: Sara (Legal): 90 days is fine if we document exceptions and approval flow. Suggest: "recommended" not "required" unless customer contract says so.
maria: Good call — will change language to "recommended cadence (e.g., 90 days)" and add exception note.
leo: Also review the SDK snippet you added for export. Let's ensure it uses the KMS-integrated call and doesn't leak credentials.
maria: snippet:
```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(kms_key='projects/prod/keys/rl-key-01')
client.export_logs(since='2025-01-01', bucket='gs://redwood-audit-exports', encryption='kms')
```
leo: probably fine but change param name to `kms_key_id` and show using env var rather than inline string.
maria: Updated snippet in PR.
devon: small editorial: don't use "encrypted in transit and at rest" twice, once near top is enough.
maria: Done.
chris: lgtm from eng. One nit: add a short note about retention downstream (customer-owned export buckets should follow their retention policy).
sara-legal: add sentence: "Exported logs are subject to the destination's retention controls; customers should configure retention to meet their compliance needs." Works.
maria: Added that line and pushed.
docs-bot: CI: prose-lint passed, link-check failed (one internal link 404)
maria: Fixing link to the KMS integration guide.
maria: pushed fix.
docs-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅
chris: approved
leo: approved
sara-legal: approved
maria: merging in 10 if no objections :thumbsup:
devon: :thumbsup:
maria: merged. Thanks everyone!
